2607.09762.title: BatteryLake: Agentic, Physics-Grounded Curation of Heterogeneous Battery Aging Data and Benchmarking
2607.09762.paper_summary: Public battery aging datasets are a critical asset for advanced health management, but their practical use is often limited by inconsistent formats, unclear schemas, and metadata scattered across repositories and publications. Current curation remains largely manual and hard to reproduce, while general-purpose data integration tools miss the domain-specific semantics of electrochemical time-series data. We present BatteryLake, a governed data lakehouse that turns raw public battery data into benchmark-ready assets through an agentic, physics-grounded curation framework, with three contributions. First, LLM agents extract metadata and synthesize dataset-specific converters, grounding every output in verbatim evidence and abstaining when none supports a value. Second, a human-in-the-loop mechanism frames verification as selective prediction and gates admitted data through 26 schema, statistical, and physical-plausibility rules. Third, we release an open benchmark of 41 datasets from over 25 institutions, with standardized SOH and RUL tasks, three split protocols, and eight baseline model families. The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/.
2607.09762.paper_summary_zh: 公共電池老化數據集是先進健康管理的重要資產，但其實際使用往往受到不一致格式、不清晰架構以及散佈於各個資料庫和出版物中的元數據的限制。當前的策展工作仍然主要依賴手動進行，且難以重現，而通用數據整合工具則忽略了電化學時間序列數據的特定領域語義。我們提出了BatteryLake，一個受管控的數據湖屋，通過一個基於物理的代理策展框架，將原始公共電池數據轉化為基準準備資產，並有三項貢獻。首先，LLM代理提取元數據並合成數據集特定的轉換器，將每個輸出基於逐字證據，並在沒有證據支持某個值時避免輸出。其次，人機協作機制將驗證框架設置為選擇性預測，並通過26個架構、統計和物理合理性規則來篩選接受的數據。第三，我們發布了一個來自25個以上機構的41個數據集的開放基準，具有標準化的SOH和RUL任務、三個拆分協議和八個基準模型系列。該平台、基準和策展協議可在https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/上公開獲取。
